title: Measurement, Uncertainty, and Standards
question: How precise is a physical number?
summary: Separate defined values from measured values and interpret significant digits, standard uncertainty, covariance, conventions, and standard states. Exact definitions and algebraic identities are not observations and receive no z-score; a z-score applies only to a declared comparison of uncertain values with covariance and dependence handled.

caveats: A chapter shell defines curriculum scope; it is not an evaluated statistical comparison.
